facts.fact: Biometric Update reports the Idarati X.0 national digital wallet project, for which eight partnership conventions were signed in February.

MAR.note: The document states no exchange between civil register and ID system.
No count or share of people holding the national ID is stated.
No number at birth is stated.
Thales customisation for DGSN is named, but no operating or maintenance arrangement for the ID system is stated.
No public register keyed on the ID number is stated.

facts.fact: Biometric Update says the DGSN issues the country's national identity cards.
